entries.title: Naraka: Bladepoint

primary.version: Current free-to-play Naraka: Bladepoint Windows live client

primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam Windows client. Record patch/date, season, account unlocks, region, hero/weapon choices, graphics settings, ranked/casual mode, cross-play state, and whether console routes were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for console capture or controller comparison.
secondary.why: Console versions are official, but PC keeps the higher capture/settings ceiling.
